owner_authority: The owner explicitly authorized Antigravity file-write tools in the disposable provider sandbox and authorized completing all corrections without another confirmation.

security_change.summary: The consumed primary never completed its stdin prompt boundary. The sole recovery preserves every private-profile, canonical no-write, suspended Job-bound and guardian control while replacing only the parent-written stdin pipe with one inherited locked read-only prompt-file handle.
removed_boundaries: global and project settings rollback copies
not_security_boundaries: presence or absence of another agy process

transport.stdin_delivery: Open the exact prompt with GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ only, OPEN_EXISTING and an inheritable handle; hash and length-check through that locked handle, reset and re-query offset zero, whitelist it with stdout/stderr in PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST, and let the child observe deterministic EOF at the file end. No parent write, flush or close deadline exists.

private_profile.copy_policy: No canonical settings, trusted workspaces, plugins, MCP definitions, caches, conversations, transcripts, or unrelated project records are copied.
private_profile.reparse_policy: The fixed transaction and private-profile leaves must be absent before fresh creation. Every existing and created component is checked for ReparsePoint or LinkType before settings writes, environment use, transcript reads, and evidence freezing.
private_profile.fixed_leaf_ownership: The private-profile leaf is intentionally deterministic for durable stale recovery. It is never reused: an existing leaf is either validated, quiesced and archived before duplicate-artifact refusal or causes a fail-closed stop. The one-shot claim plus CreateNew writes prevent ambiguous replacement. This provides integrity and fail-closed availability, not name secrecy; secrecy is supplied only by the random Job Object name.

environment_contract.secret_exclusion: The parent environment is not cloned. Credential-bearing and arbitrary AGY_*, ANTIGRAVITY_*, GEMINI_*, XDG_* entries are absent unless one is the exact AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE override. This is an exact key allowlist, not a regex-based privacy control.
environment_contract.binding: The case-insensitively sorted UTF-16LE block has an explicit double-NUL terminator. Evidence binds its complete byte hash, exact key-set hash, entry count, override paths, and inherited key names without publishing inherited values.
environment_contract.ordinary_environment_preservation: Only enumerated ordinary OS/runtime entries that exist in the parent are retained. PATH is retained and byte-bound; PSModulePath is omitted.
environment_contract.guardian_environment: The trusted guardian also clears ProcessStartInfo.Environment and reconstructs only the ordinary OS/runtime allowlist, TEMP/TMP, and exact LT_S26_* supervision values. Parent credentials are not copied to either child.

job_and_guardian.kernel_limits: KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE set, both breakaway flags absent.
job_and_guardian.atomic_binding: The provider is created suspended with PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST and cannot execute before exact PID/start identity is durably published and ResumeThread returns one.
job_and_guardian.guardian: An out-of-process guardian opens and queries the exact random Job Object before readiness, binds exact Director identity and one absolute deadline, and holds the second Job handle.
job_and_guardian.death_safety: Parent or guardian loss independently leaves one supervisor able to terminate the exact job. Simultaneous loss closes the last Job handles and kernel-terminates the tree. Shared settings remain untouched in every case.
job_and_guardian.normal_completion: Eligible only after the entire Job Object is empty, the Director signal wins before the absolute deadline, guardian status is DIRECTOR_SIGNAL_JOB_EMPTY, and canonical/private hashes remain exact.
job_and_guardian.failure_completion: Parent exit or deadline terminates the entire Job and verifies it empty. Stale recovery reopens the durable random Job, terminates it if present, checks exact provider and guardian PID/start identities, verifies canonical/private hashes, records recovery, then archives the stale private transaction.

log_and_state_resolution.forbidden_marker: Any case-insensitive occurrence of C:\Users\edwar\.gemini in the child CLI log.
log_and_state_resolution.project_state_binding: The exact private project record is hash-checked before resume and after Job emptiness. USERPROFILE/HOME/HOMEDRIVE/HOMEPATH bind tilde-based project resolution to the same private profile.
log_and_state_resolution.explicit_external_artifacts: The CLI log, frozen stdout/stderr/success-or-failure receipt/transcript copy, recovery claim, and provider sandbox are authorized paths outside the private profile. They are explicit assignment outputs, not Antigravity user state.

one_shot_controls: Recover and archive any validated stale private transaction before duplicate-artifact refusal, then end that invocation recovery-only and require a new clean preflight before provider contact.
Acquire one distinct RECOVERY1 atomic assignment claim before private-profile creation or provider contact and copy its exact bytes into the transaction root for durable archival.
Require caller-supplied exact committed control HEAD/tree and exact provider HEAD/tree/branch/clean two-file sandbox.
Refuse pre-existing recovery stdout, stderr, log, transcript, success receipt, failure receipt, or claim artifacts.
Create exactly one random kill-on-close/no-breakaway Job Object and start a guardian that opens it before provider creation.
Use one custom double-NUL Unicode environment and one atomic suspended Job-bound CreateProcessW call.
Publish exact provider PID/start identity before one ResumeThread call.
Never kill by executable name and never treat other agy processes as an exclusivity boundary.
Require full Job emptiness before normal completion and in the parent operational finally.
Require the exact isolated appDataDir and permission markers and reject canonical Gemini-root log resolution.
Freeze exact stdout, stderr, log, authenticated private-profile transcript, guardian evidence, and a strict success or failure receipt before any terminal throw.
safety_invariants: Keep --sandbox and accept-edits bound to the exact disposable provider sandbox.
Do not grant shell, browser, URL, MCP, credential, external-service, push, merge, deploy, publish, purchase, or device authority.
Only LongTableRobotDealer/** provider working-tree bytes are eligible for later OpenAI freeze.
Deserialize every control-evidence JSON timestamp with DateKind String so exact ISO tokens cannot be converted to locale-dependent DateTime text.

Any immutable-authority drift, reparse point, environment-contract drift, canonical settings drift, outside-profile state marker, forbidden tool attempt, ambiguous dispatch, or invalid result fails closed.

retry_binding.recovery_condition: Objectively temporary local stdin transport failure before a completed prompt boundary or authenticated terminal model result.
retry_binding.qa_revision_condition: Materially new exact OpenAI QA findings after a valid source delivery.
retry_binding.provider_free_selftest_commit_rule: The real recovery launch HEAD must be the sole child of the self-test control HEAD; the exact delta is only child-output.json, child.stderr and selftest-summary.json, and the launcher Git blob must remain identical.

hash_binding.direction: The launcher freezes this permission-delta SHA-256. This permission delta intentionally does not freeze the launcher SHA-256, avoiding a reverse hash cycle.
hash_binding.downstream_status: The current result-binding and OpenAI QA launcher are separately authorized and refrozen for this exact v2 evidence contract. Every schema, hash, isolation, and canonical no-write mismatch remains fail closed.
